name: A pending assignment request cannot be bypassed with Take this
description: After the owner requests Leo for a responsibility, neither the owner nor Leo is offered 'Take this'; Leo is offered 'Accept responsibility'.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Click 'Add responsibility', type 'TS water the plants' in 'What needs doing?', choose Kind 'Errand' and save
Click 'Request assignment', choose 'Leo (demo)' as the household member and confirm
Verify the responsibility detail for 'TS water the plants' does not show a 'Take this' button
Open 'Sample controls', click 'Open recipient role' and open the 'Continue as Leo in a separate tab' link
Open the responsibility 'TS water the plants'
Verify an 'Accept responsibility' button is shown
Verify no 'Take this' button is shown for 'TS water the plants'
